attachments.origin_landmark: oral surface of the palatine aponeurosis
attachments.insertion_landmark: side of the tongue, blending with the intrinsic transverse fibres

actions: elevates the back of the tongue

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Anatomically a tongue muscle but the ONLY one not supplied by CN XII -- it is palatal in origin and takes the vagus. Forms the anterior tonsillar pillar.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
